display.purpose: Hero name, landmark section headings. Used once per major section at most.

headline.purpose: Section headings with bold + italic-light mixed weight contrast.

body.purpose: All narrative prose. Lora. Max line length 65ch.

label.purpose: Operational metadata — section numbers, nav links, tags, timestamps. Never > 11px.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Default for opacity, color, border-color transitions.

motion.name: character-move
motion.purpose: Career row reveal, hover slide-in. Has weight and intent.

motion.name: expand

breakpoints.name: mobile

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Form submit. Warm terracotta fill, mono uppercase. The one button that asks for something.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #5e412d; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 40px; border: none; border-radius: 1px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.25s ease, gap 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a0714f; gap: 18px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0714f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: CTA / Ghost Button
components.description: Nav and section CTAs. Transparent with terra border — invites without demanding.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a0714f; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid rgba(160,113,79,0.25); padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 1px; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: #5e412d; color: #ffffff; border-color: #5e412d; } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a0714f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Hero tags, language pills. Operational classification in terra border.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a0714f; padding: 7px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(160,113,79,0.25); border-radius: 1px; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; cursor: default; } .ds-tag:hover { background: #5e412d; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Underline-only input. No box, no radius. Focus shifts border to terracotta.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 32px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); padding: 12px 0; font-family: 'Lora', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; color: #ffffff; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.25s ease; appearance: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); font-style: italic; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #a0714f; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #c0392b; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 52px; transition: background 0.4s ease, border-color 0.4s ease; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; z-index: 100; } .ds-nav--scrolled { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 40px; list-style: none; } .ds-nav-links a { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; opacity: 0.4; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { opacity: 1; }

components.css: .ds-career-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr auto; align-items: start; gap: 32px; padding: 36px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); position: relative; transition: background 0.3s ease, padding-left 0.3s ease; cursor: default; } .ds-career-row::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 0; background: #a0714f; transition: width 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); } .ds-career-row:hover { background: rgba(94,65,45,0.08); padding-left: 16px; } .ds-career-row:hover::before { width: 3px; } .ds-career-num { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #a0714f; padding-top: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-career-company { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #a0714f; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-career-role { font-family: 'Noto Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #ffffff; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-career-row:hover .ds-career-role { color: #a0714f; } .ds-career-desc { font-family: 'Lora', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); max-width: 560px; } .ds-career-period { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); white-space: nowrap; padding-top: 6px; }

narrative.overview:
This system operates on a principle borrowed from Jorge's own brand guide: 'não se explica, se posiciona.' It doesn't explain itself. Every element earns its place through presence, not decoration. The design vocabulary is dark, warm, and surgical — it lives at the intersection Jorge lives at: corporate authority and cultural resistance, ancestral depth and algorithmic precision. The moodboard anchors are MR. ROBOT, Neo-Noir, and Afrofuturismo — not as aesthetic costumes, but as structural references for how power can speak quietly.

The system rejects the temptation to signal. Nothing shouts cultural identity; the terracotta is a color pulled from real clothing worn on real cobblestones in Madrid, not a diversity indicator. The Noto Serif Display is a liturgical column, not a headline trick. The grain on every surface is a film texture, not a design trend.

Warm but deliberate. Every transition breathes — not elastic, not bouncy — but with the warmth of something handmade. The system never animates to please; it moves when it has a reason to move.
keyCharacteristics: Dark warm ground (#1e1a14) — charred earth, not default dark mode
Terracotta as the one warm signal — used in ≤20% of any surface
Typography that mixes vertical authority (display) with literary warmth (body)
Grain texture as the depth layer — no traditional box-shadows
DM Mono for all operational metadata
Entrance motion via GSAP — staggered reveals, never gratuitous

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Terracotta (both ancestral-root and terracotta-signal) appears on ≤20% of any given surface. Its scarcity is the entire point.

rules.name: The No Invented Colors Rule
rules.body: Use only the Futuro Preto palette. If a design requires a new color, the design is wrong — not the palette.

rules.name: The Dark Green Reserve Rule
rules.body: #273F29 is in the palette but not yet deployed. When a surface needs ancestral stability without terracotta warmth — use it intentionally.

rules.name: The Italic Contrast Rule
rules.body: Within display and headline type, italic + weight 300 signals the poetic or human dimension. Never italicize at 900 weight.

rules.name: The No-Scale Collapse Rule
rules.body: All headings use fluid clamp(). Never a fixed px heading value. The display-to-body ratio is ≥2.5× at all sizes.

rules.name: The Mono Label Ceiling Rule
rules.body: DM Mono labels never exceed 11px. Above that, mono reads as code, not metadata.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not add box-shadow to components. Depth is grain + tonal layering. A shadow is a design error in this system.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: The scrolled nav is the only component with backdrop-filter: blur. Adding blur anywhere else introduces glassmorphism — absolute ban.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce cards with border + background + shadow + radius. This system uses row lists, photo panels, and full-bleed sections.

dos: Use only the five official Futuro Preto colors plus their site derivations.
Use #1e1a14 as the page background — warm near-black, not #000000.
Use Noto Serif Display for all titles, headings, and display type.
Mix Noto Serif bold + italic-light for headings — the 'DECLARATION. qualifier.' pattern.
Apply the SVG grain texture to any new full-page surface.
Use DM Mono for all labels, metadata, section numbers, tags, and timestamps.
Use clamp() for all heading sizes.
Check brand_assets/ before writing any placeholder.
Keep transitions warm but deliberate: 0.2s–0.4s ease for state changes.
donts: Don't use box-shadow anywhere. Depth is grain + tonal layering.
Don't add backdrop-filter: blur to any component except the scrolled nav.
Don't build card grids — the system uses row lists and full-bleed sections.
Don't make the site look like a Generic SaaS Portfolio (navy + white, feature list, CTA grid).
Don't make it look like a LinkedIn-style resume — timeline-heavy, credential-first, corporate.
Don't use terracotta as a fill for large surfaces. Its rarity is its power.
Don't import DePretoPraPreto's visual language into the personal brand.
Don't use transition-all. Specify exactly which properties transition.
Don't use the default Tailwind palette as filler.
Don't add new fonts — the three-family system is complete.
Don't use gradient-text (background-clip: text). Absolute ban.
Don't add border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't center-stack everything. Left-aligned asymmetric layouts are the default.
